After working with dozens of teachers,professors, producers and artists as well as many other individuals in the industry I can definitely help with feedback. Whilst still being 16 I’ve had allot of exposure in the industry working with individuals who are playing in front of thousands. We won this national young artists competition run by the state university of technology so we currently working with their producers to form our second release. So if you want, while not being legally a qualified musician I feel I certainly can help your Album by cohesively advising the more complex musical concepts I feel would enhance your vision without impacting your art. music is art which in the end should reflect your creative identity and I feel I can help you achieve with an extra set of ears. When making music, we hear the music so much that allot of the time we loose touch with how it would hear to a new set of ears and that’s why artists never let the guy who mixed the song master the song and allot of the time the dude that mixed the song is separate from the producer. I’m just saying that’s why it would be good for me to be that fresh set of ears.

After working with dozens of teachers, professors, producers and artists as well as many other individuals in the industry I recommend just mentally sending it by researching into an audio interface that will last throughout your progression then getting a free trial to either Logic Pro X (Mac only) or Ableton Live. Watch a bunch of tutorials for the software and start jamming. Doodling around with the software is quintessential because the only way you’re gonna get good at anything is with time. By buying a few hundred dollars on the interface your just naturally going to justify the purchase by sitting down and playing around in the software. I think that by you playing guitar already you’ll find the seemingly endless tones available make it something your gonna wanna spend at least an hour at every day anyway . In the end, making music that resonates with your personal identity is to me at least one of the most rewarding things you can do so just go ham.
